visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a large warehouse filled with stacked cardboard boxes labeled 'ATLDO'. A young man wearing glasses, a white hoodie, and a black vest sits on the floor surrounded by open boxes. He is physically sealing a box with clear packing tape using a red tape dispenser. The lighting is bright and industrial. (2) The man stands up and begins pulling various car care products from the boxes, holding them close to the camera lens. He displays bottles with black and blue labels and small blue sponges. His facial expressions are animated and energetic, with frequent hand gestures pointing at the product details. (3) The setting shifts to an indoor car service garage with several cars visible, including a white Volvo and a black MG. The man stands next to the white car, demonstrating a cleaning process. He pours a yellow liquid from a plastic bottle onto the windshield and then uses a blue sponge to scrub the glass. (4) Close-up shots show the application of a white cream-like substance on the car's glass. The man's hands are seen moving in circular motions. Then, a water hose is used to spray the glass, showing clear water beading and sheeting off the surface. (5) On the black car, the man demonstrates a coating product. He sprays a liquid from a black bottle and wipes it with a light blue cloth. He then places a bottle on the hood, which slides off smoothly due to the coating. The video ends with him pointing at the camera.
